scope: Selected dictionary cells and conditions in EC3 Table 176 Link, Table 177 FreeText, and Table 178 Line; no whole-clause certification.

primary_source.locator_method: Table headings and printed footer were checked in the primary PDF; printed-page numbers are not inferred from extracted cross-reference hits.

cells.source: table physical 498 / printed 483; clause introduction physical 497 / printed 482

entries.requirement: Required; Link
entries.assertion: Current link fixtures use /Subtype /Link; public Query::LinkAt and activation fixtures exercise the Link consumer.

entries.requirement: Optional; Dest is not permitted when A is present
entries.assertion: Current action/destination tests cover direct Dest, actions, named destinations, and action-chain GoTo; malformed simultaneous A+Dest is not treated as a valid-input rejection requirement in this audit.

entries.requirement: Optional; default I; N/I/O/P behavior on pointer press
entries.assertion: link_highlighting_audit.rs checks I and N plus absent-H default I; link_highlighting_residual_audit.rs checks O border-only, P/down appearance, and absent-H with /D against explicit I.

entries.requirement: Optional former URI action retained when changing a URI link to GoTo, for possible restoration if the target page is later deleted.
entries.assertion: This is optional authoring bookkeeping, not an additional-action event. Generic AA trigger tests do not establish PA support; no mandatory reader dispatch duty inferred.

entries.requirement: Optional PDF 1.6; eight numbers per quadrilateral in default user space; if absent/unrecognized or any coordinate lies outside Rect, activation region is Rect
entries.assertion: link_quadpoints_audit.rs tests valid smaller region, pointer/highlight outside it, and an escaping coordinate falling back to Rect with inside/outside controls; pdf-model/tests/links.rs corpus census observes two links with multiple quads. Exact tests assert no parser recovery.

entries.requirement: Optional; EC3 #299 changes producer version marker to PDF 1.3; link border dictionary specifies width/dash
entries.assertion: annotation_border_audit and link_default_border_spec_audit cover construction/defaults and border precedence. Border is visually independent of QuadPoints per EC3 #17.

entries.requirement: Required; FreeText
entries.assertion: free_text_annotation_spec_audit.rs uses standalone page /Annots fixture; not a widget in AcroForm Fields.

entries.requirement: Required formatting string
entries.assertion: Current standalone and variable-text fixtures use DA; variable_text.rs covers DA text layout, font resources, size, color and malformed/unavailable cases. A required producer cell does not imply a malformed-reader refusal duty.

entries.requirement: Optional; default 0, left/center/right values 0/1/2
entries.assertion: free_text_annotation_spec_audit.rs compares absent with 0 and distinct centered/right controls.

entries.requirement: Optional rich text/default style; RC used for appearance generation under supported XFA subset; DS applies its supported style
entries.assertion: variable_text.rs and rich_text.rs cover Contents/RC precedence, rich text rendering, and default style. This shard does not certify all XFA 3.3.

entries.requirement: Optional; meaningful only when IT=FreeTextCallout; exactly four or six default-user-space coordinates
entries.assertion: variable_text.rs compares straight/bent geometries, outside-Rect placement, endpoint LE, IT gating for FreeText/FreeTextCallout/FreeTextTypeWriter, and invalid 5-coordinate report with readable note preserved. Its current helper puts FreeText in AcroForm Fields, a widget-shaped/nonconforming fixture for a standalone FreeText subtype; parent is correcting callout helper fixtures to use /Fields []. Do not count existing calls as fully valid-input evidence until rerun.

entries.requirement: Optional; default FreeText; valid FreeText, FreeTextCallout, FreeTextTypeWriter
entries.assertion: annotations.rs checks subtype-conditioned intent values; variable_text.rs verifies callout line exists only for FreeTextCallout.

entries.requirement: Optional PDF 1.6; used with BS
entries.assertion: freetext_cloud_border_spec_audit.rs now asserts cloud border width/dash on a standalone FreeText annotation; parent reports PASS at freetext-border-wave102.log. Cloud pixel form remains selected implementation artwork.

entries.requirement: Optional; [left top right bottom], defines inner text rectangle; border/effect apply to inner rectangle
entries.assertion: free_text_annotation_spec_audit.rs independently insets each edge and separates text inset from default-user-space callout geometry.

entries.requirement: Optional; EC3 #299 changes producer version marker to PDF 1.3; width/dash border settings
entries.assertion: Standalone cloud border test and border precedence controls exercise BS. AP-present path precedence is covered separately in variable_text.rs.

entries.requirement: Optional; meaningful only with CL; line-ending name at (x1,y1)
entries.assertion: variable_text.rs compares no ending with ClosedArrow and verifies added marks are only at the first callout endpoint.

entries.requirement: Subtype required as Line; L required as two endpoint pairs
entries.assertion: Line geometry tests render line; line measurement test uses independent 3-4-5 geometry and units.

entries.requirement: Optional; L points are leader endpoints when LL is present; signed length chooses direction
entries.assertion: annotations.rs and line_ending_endpoint_spec_audit.rs distinguish positive/negative sign, translated line, leaders, and offset/extension boundaries.

entries.requirement: Optional nonnegative extension and gap lengths
entries.assertion: line-annotation raster tests assert empty start gap and exact source-derived interior/extension controls.

entries.requirement: Optional two endpoint names; IC fills applicable closed line-ending shapes
entries.assertion: line_ending_endpoint_spec_audit.rs checks first/second endpoint; annotations.rs checks each Table 179 shape, fill/no-fill set, reversed arrows, and Issue #515's RClosedArrow fill.

entries.requirement: Optional; when true Contents or RC shall be replicated as caption
entries.assertion: annotations.rs has positive caption and absent-Cap controls; absent Contents/RC owes no caption.

entries.requirement: Optional; values LineArrow and LineDimension
entries.assertion: annotations.rs compares subtype-specific intent values and absent intent.

entries.requirement: Optional; meaningful only when Cap true; default Inline, valid Inline/Top
entries.assertion: annotations.rs contrasts omitted CP (Inline) with explicit Top and checks caption ink relative to the line.

entries.requirement: Optional; specifies scale and units
entries.assertion: annotations.rs uses independent 3-4-5 line length and scale factor 2; leadered equivalent has same measured length.

entries.requirement: Optional; meaningful only when Cap true; default [0,0]
entries.assertion: annotations.rs uses positive perpendicular offset control and asserts original rows become empty/new rows are inked; default inline placement is separately asserted.

assertion_limits: Tests that render constructed appearance do not certify all stored AP behavior; those routes have separate appearance-stream tests.
Producer validity conditions (required fields, permitted names, version markers) are not converted into reader refusal requirements without a separate reader shall.
This selected cell audit does not certify all PA triggers, all XFA chapter 27 syntax, exact cloud artwork, every host interaction, or every malformed-input policy.

The existing variable_text.rs callout helper puts its FreeText annotation in AcroForm /Fields; those cases are not valid standalone subtype fixtures until the parent's helper correction is rerun. Older RC tests also need their own fixture-shape audit before being promoted as valid-input evidence.
